title: Craft School: Stick Adventures
meta_description: Help stickman complete his school training by overcoming fun filled challenges!
full_description: The heroes of world craft quarreled together in the same monster class! Jump & Slash challenge in the Craft School game! Become the best, show what you can do. The game implies that for a while you will enroll in an odd school that is situated on the grounds of the block craft cubic universe. Here, you can practice techniques that you'll need to solve a variety of difficulties in everyday life. Additionally, the original cube school offers thrilling parkour lessons where you can master run, acrobatic dizzying jumps. To overcome difficulties and cross the finish gate, they must be finished on time. Maintain your focus to avoid losing by falling into the lava and abyss. A journey on a sort of roller coaster that takes place deep inside the mine will be another pleasant surprise. We are sure you will have a lot of fun playing this game!   ✌️ Survival Game: Survive the and wood bridge challenges ✌️ Siren Head: Survive Siren Head attack and blow it up with all TNTs ✌️ Parkour: Dash from block to block, jump over obstacles, and master your landing tricks ✌️ Zombie Apocalypse: attack and defeat all zombies & monster.  📌 Awesome pixel graphics and animation 📌 Ultimate fun lessons levels to test your skills 📌 New pixel maps and landscapes in every level 📌 Various characters and skins to upgrade  It's thrilling time for you to challenge your brave. Will you survive? Let's try in Craft School
